physics.eos: FreeEOS 3.0 EOS1 material Helmholtz potential + radiation; metals represented by helium; fixed composition
physics.opacity: AESOPUS 2.1 gas + TOPS ATOMIC GS98, Z=0.020, no extrapolation
physics.atmosphere: AMES-COND-2000 non-grey via MESA; untouched cool-dwarf cells
physics.atmosphere_composition_approximation: GN93 solar proxy; atmosphere and interior mixtures are not matched
physics.composition: X=0.7, Z=0.02, AAG21 resolved metals (GS98 opacity approximation)

limitations: fixed-composition EOS; source-fit joins regularized by C2 interpolation (see docs/FREEEOS.md); He3 and composition evolution unavailable; thin atmosphere; interior has no grain opacity, conduction, mixing, or evolution; alpha uncalibrated
